title: Snapshots
description: Per-pair cumulative influence snapshots. Architecture §3 row 4, Pipeline Spec §10.4.

delta_you.description: Δ(t, you) — sum of scores where pair_added = t and speaker = U.

delta_ai.description: Δ(t, AI) — sum of scores where pair_added = t and speaker = A.

c_you.description: C(t, you) — cumulative sum of Δ(t', you) for t' ≤ t.

c_ai.description: C(t, AI) — cumulative sum of Δ(t', AI) for t' ≤ t.
